value.body: A BBA track focused on reaching customers — consumer behaviour, market research, brand management, advertising, sales and distribution, and digital marketing (search, social media, web analytics).

items.label: Regulator
items.note: Alongside the affiliating university; BBA, BCA and BMS were brought under AICTE from 2024-25

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Admission is by Class 12 marks, CUET-UG, or a university's own test. Most students pick the specialisation in the second or third year; some institutes admit directly to a named programme.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many entry roles are in sales or business development, often with targets and incentives.
Digital marketing roles expect hands-on skill with ad platforms, analytics and content; short certifications and a portfolio are common.
Brand-management roles are often filled through MBA campus hiring.
Common next step: an MBA (Marketing), often after a few years of work.

AISHE counts only institutions that responded to the survey; coverage varies by year, so part of any change can reflect reporting rather than real growth.
